description: Discover the collections visible to you. Lean overview — one entry per collection. Returns id, name (display label), schema (the schema id this collection uses), description, url_pattern, access level, and total_objects (so you can decide whether to paginate or enumerate). For the per-property detail of one collection (which properties exist, which are filterable/sortable), call describe_collection. Then query_collection / search_collection / get_object for the data.
name: list_collections

collections.description: Persona-filtered list, sorted alphabetically by id.

description.description: Resolved mcp.description, falling back to the schema description.

name.description: Display label, falls back to id.

url_pattern.description: URL template for objects, e.g. "/blog/{id}". Empty string when no pattern is configured.

total.description: Number of collections in the response (post-persona-filter).
